title: RoadPilot release manifest
description: Documents the shape of release-manifest.json. The authoritative checks are implemented in scripts/Test-ReleaseManifest.ps1 (Windows PowerShell 5.1 has no JSON Schema validator); this file is the reference for editors and future tooling.

status.description: 'example' may contain UNRESOLVED values. 'verified' must not: every repository needs a full 40-character commit SHA and release.version must be a SemVer string.

version.description: SemVer of the RoadPilot release, or UNRESOLVED (example only).

id.description: Unique key used by dependsOn and buildOrder.

version.description: This repository's own version (repositories do not share one), or UNRESOLVED (example only).

commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase hex SHA, or UNRESOLVED (example only).

tag.description: Optional informational tag. The commit SHA is authoritative. Branch names are never accepted.

dependencyEvidence.description: Where a declared dependency was observed. Required whenever dependsOn is not empty.

buildOrder.description: Repository ids in build order. Each dependency must appear before its dependents.
